scope: Bounded local declared cache/build/receipt locations. Full archives opaque SHA/header inspection; ONLY public index.html and asset-manifest.json streamed in memory for local-reference closure. No extraction or private payloads.
limits: Public index binding establishes historical published bytes for the index, not a current full remote asset readback or inactivity.
All builds without a matching independent publication receipt remain candidate evidence and do not count as historical rollback versions.
Frontend closure checks index local references and asset-manifest file names against archive headers; no arbitrary JS/CSS payloads or dependency chain execution/read occurred.
Backend code archives alone would need runtime/dependency/configuration/inactivity recovery evidence; no new complete backend version was established.

Qualified publication-review archive/index bindings are reported separately from full-build index hashes; protected/incumbent root assets were retained by publisher, so archive-only historical full-version equivalence is not inferred.
